# اِسْتَأْمَرْتِ (istaʔmarti) /is.taʔ.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# اِسْتَأْمَرَتْ (istaʔmarat) /is.t
